instruction: Create a reusable workflow triggered by workflow_call and call it from another workflow in the same repo.
output:
name: caller-local
on: push
jobs:
  ci:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/reusable-ci.yml

---
# reusable-ci.yml
name: reusable-ci
on:
  workflow_call:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci && npm test

instruction: Define a reusable workflow with a node-version input and a default value.
output:
name: reusable-input-default
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/node-test.yml
    with:
      node-version: 22

---
# node-test.yml
name: node-test
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      node-version:
        description: Node.js version to test
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 20
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}
      - run: npm ci && npm test

instruction: Expose a job output from a reusable workflow and print it in the caller.
output:
name: reusable-outputs
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build.yml
  print:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Built artifact ${{ needs.build.outputs.artifact }}"

---
# build.yml
name: build
on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      artifact:
        description: Name of the built artifact
        value: ${{ jobs.compile.outputs.artifact }}
jobs:
  compile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      artifact: ${{ steps.build.outputs.name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: build
        run: echo "name=app-${{ github.sha }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

instruction: Call a reusable workflow with secrets: inherit to forward all repository secrets.
output:
name: secrets-inherit
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml
    secrets: inherit

---
# deploy.yml
name: deploy
on:
  workflow_call:
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Deploy
        env:
          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
        run: ./scripts/deploy.sh

instruction: Declare a required secret explicitly in a reusable workflow and pass it from the caller.
output:
name: explicit-secret
on: push
jobs:
  publish:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/publish.yml
    secrets:
      npm-token:
        ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

---
# publish.yml
name: publish
on:
  workflow_call:
    secrets:
      npm-token:
        description: npm registry token
        required: true
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: npm ci && npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.npm-token }}

instruction: Write a reusable workflow that itself runs a matrix of Node versions.
output:
name: reusable-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/matrix-test.yml

---
# matrix-test.yml
name: matrix-test
on:
  workflow_call:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm ci && npm test

instruction: Pass several typed inputs from the caller into the reusable workflow's steps.
output:
name: typed-reusable-inputs
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  build:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/configurable-build.yml
    with:
      configuration: production
      optimize: true
      workers: 4

---
# configurable-build.yml
name: configurable-build
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      configuration:
        type: string
        required: true
      optimize:
        type: boolean
        default: false
      workers:
        type: number
        default: 1
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/build.sh --config ${{ inputs.configuration }} --workers ${{ inputs.workers }}
        env:
          OPTIMIZE: ${{ inputs.optimize }}

instruction: Make a reusable workflow usable from both workflow_call and manual workflow_dispatch.

instruction: Create a reusable deploy workflow that takes the environment name as an input.

jobs:
  deploy:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-env.yml
    with:

---

instruction: Write a composite action with action.yml that installs dependencies for any project.
output:
name: composite-install
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-deps
        with:
          manager: npm

---
# .github/actions/install-deps/action.yml
name: Install dependencies
description: Install project dependencies with the chosen package manager
inputs:
  manager:
    description: Package manager to use
    required: true
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Install
      shell: bash
      run: |
        case "${{ inputs.manager }}" in
          npm) npm ci ;;
          pnpm) pnpm install --frozen-lockfile ;;
          yarn) yarn install --frozen-lockfile ;;
        esac

instruction: Create a composite action that exposes an output computed in a bash step.
output:
name: composite-output
on: push
jobs:
  meta:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: gitmeta
        uses: ./.github/actions/git-meta
      - run: echo "short sha is ${{ steps.gitmeta.outputs.short_sha }}"

---
# .github/actions/git-meta/action.yml
name: Git metadata
description: Expose short commit information
outputs:
  short_sha:
    description: Short commit SHA
    value: ${{ steps.read.outputs.short_sha }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - id: read
      shell: bash
      run: echo "short_sha=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

instruction: Build a reusable workflow that notifies a channel, ignoring failures inside it.
output:
name: reusable-notify
on: push
jobs:
  notify:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/notify.yml

---
# notify.yml
name: notify
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      message:
        type: string
        required: true
jobs:
  send:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Send message
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}
        run: |
          curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data "{\"text\":\"${{ inputs.message }}\"}" "$SLACK_WEBHOOK"

instruction: Provide both the inputs and secrets definitions for a reusable release workflow in one example.
output:
name: full-release-reusable
on: push
jobs:
  release:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/release.yml
    with:
      channel: stable
      draft: false
    secrets:
      gh-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

---
# release.yml
name: release
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      channel:
        type: string
        required: true
      draft:
        type: boolean
        default: false
    secrets:
      gh-token:
        required: true
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/release.sh --channel ${{ inputs.channel }} --draft ${{ inputs.draft }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.gh-token }}

instruction: Write a reusable versioning workflow that computes and returns a semantic version.
output:
name: reusable-version
on: push
jobs:
  version:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/version.yml
  use:
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Next version is ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"

---
# version.yml
name: version
on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      version:
        description: Computed semantic version
        value: ${{ jobs.compute.outputs.version }}
jobs:
  compute:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.calc.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - id: calc
        run: echo "version=1.${{ github.run_number }}.0" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

instruction: Create a reusable test workflow that spins up a service container for the caller's tests.
output:
name: reusable-services
on: push
jobs:
  integration:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/integration.yml

---
# integration.yml
name: integration
on:
  workflow_call:
jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run test:integration
        env:
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379

instruction: Pass github.token into a reusable workflow job through the secrets mapping.
output:
name: token-to-reusable
on: push
jobs:
  pages:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/upload-pages.yml
    secrets:
      token: ${{ github.token }}

---
# upload-pages.yml
name: upload-pages
on:
  workflow_call:
    secrets:
      token:
        required: true
jobs:
  upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./dist
      - run: echo "Artifact uploaded with ${{ secrets.token }}"
